text.tspan: OSI (7 layers, the teaching model) vs TCP/IP (4 layers, what runs)
Say: "OSI is a reference model for talking about networks; TCP/IP is what's implemented. We still use OSI numbers,
like L4 vs L7 load balancers." Some books give TCP/IP 5 layers, keeping Physical separate.
